title: DPC-PINN-Wasserstein: physics-informed joint conductivity-porosity mapping with Wasserstein-2 experimental design
description: MATLAB implementation and curated dataset for a physics-informed neural network that jointly infers hydraulic conductivity and effective porosity in alluvial aquifers, with conformal-calibrated uncertainty and a Wasserstein-2 optimal experimental design criterion. Demonstrated on the Fushe-Kuqe alluvial aquifer, northwestern Albania.
